interpretation.species: Sneasel resolved near the opening in both recordings; timing measures crop to publication, not first appearance to screen paint.
interpretation.audio: Feint Attack was independently supported by repeated accepted audio references in both recordings. The first SFX-only clip was rejected by the changing-spectrum margin; next accepted cue was delayed. Do not weaken audio thresholds based on these two matches.
interpretation.energyDeadline: Bundled Sneasel movepool permits a 40-energy move at 6 seconds via Ice Shard, 7 seconds via Feint Attack from zero uninterrupted energy. Exact move identification was later than this theoretical earliest deadline in both recordings.
interpretation.forecast: The separate elapsed-time energy hypothesis remains in place; this review does not measure its exact first HUD paint time. Do not equate observed-use energy with complete energy accounting.
interpretation.hp: White Abomasnow art generated nested candidates sharing the bottom HP edge. Top-only deduplication left more than two candidates, so the tracker rejected both sides. This is reproducible from retained raw frames; it does not establish the cause of every live measurement gap.
interpretation.storage: Compact keeps all measurement articles. Uncited whole-frame artifacts remain internally; sparse file modification time is not a capture timestamp.

change.behavior: Collapse duplicate rectangles only when their end caps align, they share a top or bottom edge, and at least 75 percent of the smaller vertical interior overlaps. Keep the highest-confidence rectangle. Separate conflicting bars still reject.

deviceRecordedPixelCheck.scope: Controlled recorded images through live shared locator, local recovery, and same-source two-side witness fanout. Not concurrent live Pokemon GO performance.

remainingAcceptance: New live match must verify sustained measurements, individual fast-move counts, and timely identity/energy before the first charge. Recorded-pixel tests do not prove end-to-end live performance.
